evidence: The reactants included two organometallic precursors: trimethylaluminum (Al(CH3)3, TMA, 98%, Strem) and diethyl zinc (Zn(C2H5)2, DEZ, 96%, Strem) and deionized water vapor (DI H2O). High-purity Ar (99.999%) (National Welders Supply Co.) was used as the purge and carrier gas and further purified by a gas filter (DRIERITE Gas Purifier) before entering the reaction system.
